name: mafft_command
short: MAFFT 7.505 as a command line (the script mafft: options parsed as the script does, the pipeline of ported programs, FASTA / CLUSTAL / PHYLIP output, tree and distance files, the program's standard error); equal to the installed program on the committed command lines.
description: The script mafft of MAFFT 7.505 as a function of its command line and the text of the files it names (MafftProgram.Run): the options are parsed as the script does, the strategy is derived as the script does and the ported programs run in the script's order; output = FASTA / CLUSTAL / PHYLIP text, the files (--out, name.tree, name.hat2, name.notused) and the standard error byte for byte. See the tool description in the code for the options.

exitCode: 0 = success, 1 = the script or a program stops with an error (usage text, unknown option, missing file, unknown letter ...).
stdout: The alignment in the output format (empty with --out).
stderr: The messages of the script and of the programs it runs (empty with --quiet), or the usage text.
files: The files the run wrote: --out, name.tree (--treeout / --nodeout), name.hat2 (--distout), name.notused (--sparsepickup), the --progress file.

errors: an option whose program is not ported yet (NotSupported, the message names the option)
the file '-' is read from stdin
a refused command line is an exit status 1 with the script's own message in stderr

example.title: Three proteins, CLUSTAL output
example.prompt: Align these three sequences with MAFFT and give the CLUSTAL format.

output.stdout:
CLUSTAL format alignment by MAFFT FFT-NS-2 (v7.505)


a               MKVLAAGIVGLLLA
b               MKVL-AGIVGLLA-
c               MKVIAAGLVGLLLA
                ***: **:****

example.note: The output equals `mafft --quiet --clustalout ex.fa` of the installed Debian mafft 7.505-1.
